LESSON: HUMAN SEXUALITY: RESPONSIBLE SEXUAL BEHAVIOUR

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.2: Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Human Sexuality: Responsible Sexual Behaviour, part of Christian Living Today in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should you live responsibly as a youth?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Self-awareness: The learners appreciate their body as the temple of the Holy Spirit and avoid irresponsible sexual behaviour.

• Assertiveness: The learners exercise self-control by saying ‘No!’ to irresponsible sexual behaviour.

• Human sexuality-Abstinence: The learners make a decision not to engage in irresponsible sexual behaviour before marriage

(I Corinthians 6:18-20).

• Life skills: The learners overcome growth and developmental changes by overcoming lust and depending on God to

overcome temptations.

• Peer pressure resistance: The learners apply life skills in their interactions to avoid negative peer influence.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. identify forms of sexual abuse and how to avoid or overcome abuse,
2. evaluate causes of teenage pregnancies today,
3. examine the consequences of engaging in irresponsible sexual behaviour,
4. discuss values and life skills needed to avoid irresponsible sexual behaviour,
5. choose to live responsibly as guided by the word of God,
6. respect their bodies by living a morally upright life .

Remember the key question: Why should you live responsibly as a youth?
